stories.title: Team USA Olympic stock watch: Why we're monitoring these 11 NBA players
stories.summary: Whose Olympic stock has risen and fallen? Let's analyze 11 players based on their performances over the second half of the 2025-26 season and postseason.

stories.title: Draymond returns to Warriors on 1-year deal
stories.summary: Draymond Green has agreed to return to the Warriors on a one-year, $27.7 million deal.

stories.title: Eagles' Carter now highest-paid DT in NFL history
stories.summary: The Eagles are signing two-time Pro Bowl selection Jalen Carter to a four-year, $152 million extension worth up to $160 million, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Jason Rosenhaus told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Sources: No real progress in Mayfield, Bucs talks
stories.summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield is reporting to training camp without a new deal and will play out the final year of his contract before becoming a free agent, sources told ESPN on Tuesday.

stories.title: QB Cousins gets nod over Mendoza to open camp
stories.summary: Klint Kubiak said veteran QB Kirk Cousins will open training camp as the Raiders' starter, in front of No. 1 pick Fernando Mendoza.
